contactParagraph: Share the basics of your project and the Grand View team can follow up to discuss the next steps.
contactLets: Let us talk about your project.
contactAboutP: For tile and marble work, plumbing and pipe fitting, electrical service enquiries or property finishing needs, send a message with a few details about the job.
faq1A: Grand View is based in Abu Dhabi, UAE. Share the exact project location so the team can confirm availability for the site.
faq2Q: Can I send photos or drawings?
faq2A: Yes. Photos, dimensions, drawings and material references can make the first conversation more useful. You can send them in WhatsApp after opening the prepared enquiry.
faq3Q: Do you provide a quote before work starts?
faq3A: Project scope, materials, site conditions and timing should be discussed before costs and work details are agreed.
faq4A: Include the property location, type of space, service required, approximate area or quantity, desired timing and any access requirements.
formParagraph: Complete the form and it will prepare a message for you to review and send through WhatsApp.
formStatus: This form does not store your details. WhatsApp opens so you can review and send the message yourself.
formRequired: Please complete the required fields marked with * before continuing.
